description: This source file defines a set of UI tests for the CanvasA2 application within the OpenClawKit project. It includes test cases for verifying command string stability, JSONL decoding and validation, and rejection of invalid or unknown JSON messages.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing UI tests for CanvasA2 features.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that specific command string constants match their expected raw values.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of JSONL messages conforming to version 0.8.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that certain JSONL messages (e.g., createSurface for version 0.9) are correctly rejected as invalid.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Checks that unknown JSON message shapes are properly rejected.
